title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(五十嵐寛研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Igarashi Yutaka)
educationalGoal: In this course, students acquire the problem-solving skills related to ICT engineering. Through this process, especially in relation to information security, students will cultivate abilities in the areas of problem setting, production process development, information collection, communications, and making objective evaluations.
advice: The aim of this course is to help students acquire the skills needed to plan and develop projects in the following fields, including not only in terms of technical security but also in relation to social and human relationships: ・ OS security ・ Network security ・ Database security ・ Access control / Authentication / Encryption ・ Antivirus ・ Unauthorized access ・ Protection of information ・ Block fraud/harmful information ・ Development method for secure software ・ Evaluation and audit for security ・ Education and enlightenment activities for security
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: It is important to accumulate results for this course. Students are expected to conduct self-checks at every milestone, make progress reports for each semester, and create interim presentations.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set one-year achievement goals in relation to your chosen research.
Be able to set a specific production approach based on your set research concept.
Be able to use your acquired information engineering expertise to advance your design and analysis efforts.
Be able to cope with various problems that occur during the design and analysis process.
Be able to technically describe what you have accomplished in a convincing manner.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
